protocol.name: iosc_iosurface

description.summary: zero-copy IOSurface buffers for the iosc compositor

protocol.description: iOS has no DRM/dma-buf, and a mach send right cannot traverse the Wayland socket's SCM_RIGHTS fd-passing. So instead of zwp_linux_dmabuf_v1, a client that renders on the GPU (via ANGLE's EGL_ANGLE_iosurface_client_buffer) shares its rendered IOSurface with the compositor out-of-band: it calls IOSurfaceCreateMachPort() to get a port name in its own task, then names that port (plus geometry) in create_buffer. The compositor reaches into the client's task (task_for_pid + mach_port_extract_right, keyed by the Wayland socket's peer pid) and IOSurfaceLookupFromMachPort()s the surface — the same rendezvous the Xios DDX uses for the app hand-off, run in reverse. This is the Owl zowl_iosurface_v1 shape, adapted to our existing IOSurface plumbing.

interface.name: iosc_iosurface
interface.description: Every buffer is a BGRA8 IOSurface imported from the client task. Every commit is paired with a brokered MTLSharedEvent acquire fence; unfenced presentation is invalid.

entry.name: import_failed
entry.summary: the named mach port could not be imported as an IOSurface

entry.name: unsupported_format
entry.summary: the requested IOSurface format or flags are unsupported

entry.name: invalid_fence
entry.summary: the shared-event token or signal value is invalid

enum.name: format

description.summary: IOSurface pixel format and presentation flags

enum.description: The low bits identify the IOSurface pixel layout. The high bits are compositor presentation flags for clients whose render target origin differs from iosc's output coordinate system. Unknown low-bit formats or unknown high-bit flags are protocol errors.

entry.name: bgra8888_gl_origin
entry.summary: BGRA8 IOSurface rendered with GL-style bottom-left origin

entry.name: flag_top_left
entry.summary: buffer contents are already in top-left presentation order

request.name: create_buffer

description.summary: wrap a client IOSurface as a wl_buffer

request.description: Create a wl_buffer from an IOSurface the client has rendered into. The compositor imports the surface named by mach_port_name (an IOSurfaceCreateMachPort() name in THIS client's IPC space) by reaching into the client's task. width/height are advisory; the compositor trusts the imported surface's own geometry. format carries an iosc_iosurface.format value: BGRA8 is currently the only pixel layout, with optional presentation flags such as flag_top_left. If the import fails the buffer is created but immediately posts iosc_iosurface.error.import_failed.

arg.name: mach_port_name
arg.summary: IOSurfaceCreateMachPort() name in the client's task

request.name: set_acquire_fence

description.summary: set a brokered GPU acquire fence for the next commit

request.description: token is the fixed 32-byte capability under which the producer published its persistent MTLSharedEventHandle to the Xios NSXPC broker. value_lo/value_hi form the unsigned 64-bit value the compositor's ANGLE command queue waits for before sampling buffer. The request must precede the wl_surface.commit that attaches or damages this buffer. The same token is reused with increasing values.
